title: AI Legal Document Review: Key Terms and Summaries in Seconds
summary: Upload a contract as PDF or Word and get back its key terms and a plain-language summary of the clauses that matter.
headline: Contracts summarised in plain English
problem: Reading long contracts, agreements and legal opinions is slow, and the important clauses are easy to miss, especially for non-lawyers.
solution: LegalEase uses natural language processing to extract and summarise the key details from legal documents. Users upload a PDF or DOCX and receive concise summaries that highlight the critical clauses and terms.
highlights: Designed for both professionals and non-experts

results.label: Complex documents reviewed in a fraction of the time
Critical clauses and terms surfaced instead of buried
